From the visible “Registry Information” section of the IANA delegation record for .MUSEUM (https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html), the required fields are:

- Top-level-domain type: sponsored top-level domain (sTLD)
- Sponsoring organization: Museum Domain Management Association
- Registration date: 2001-10-08
- WHOIS server: whois.nic.museum
- Registration-services website: https://about.museum

No domain registration or contact actions were initiated; values are taken directly from the delegation page’s Registry Information fields, using the registration date (not the last-updated date) and preserving organization and server names as displayed.
